name: What is the process for starting a staircase remodeling project with Hometelligent Inc.?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for starting a staircase remodeling project with Hometelligent Inc.?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our process begins with an initial consultation to discuss your vision, budget, and functional needs. Following this, we conduct an on-site assessment to evaluate your existing staircase and gather precise measurements. We then present design options and a detailed proposal. A crucial preparation step is to consider your desired aesthetic, practical requirements, and how the staircase functions within your home's overall design before our first meeting.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process starts with a consultation, followed by an on-site assessment, design presentation, and detailed proposal. Consider your aesthetic and practical needs beforehand.
